title: Golden Haloumi Schnitzels
subtitle: with Smashed Potatoes and Green Beans
description: You can't go wrong with haloumi, right? Here it's coated in crumbs and pan-fried until golden. Teamed with crunchy smashed potatoes and tender green beans, it's a dinner that's destined to impress.

steps.text: Roast potatoes: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Halve the unpeeled potatoes and put on the lined tray. Drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and scatter over 1¼ tsp Spanish spice blend. Season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast for 20-25 mins until tender.

Crumb haloumi schnitzels: Meanwhile, trim the beans. Drain the haloumi and dry on paper towel. Halve the haloumi horizontally. Whisk 1 egg in a shallow bowl. Put the breadcrumbs and 1 tbs plain flour in separate shallow bowls. Dust the haloumi with flour, shake off the excess, then dip in the egg and coat in the breadcrumbs.

Smash potatoes: Using a potato masher or the back of a large spoon, lightly press down on each potato to smash. Scatter over the sunflower seeds and drizzle with 2 tsp honey. Roast for a further 5 mins or until golden.

Cook schnitzels and beans: Heat 1½ tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium heat. Cook the haloumi schnitzels for 3-4 mins each side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of salted water to the boil. Add the beans and cook for 2-3 mins until tender. Drain.
Serve up: Divide the haloumi schnitzels, beans and smashed potatoes among plates. Enjoy!
Make it yours: Like a creamy sauce for dipping? Combine the remaining Spanish spice blend, 2 tbs mayonnaise, ½ tsp white wine vinegar and 1 tsp water in a bowl. Serve on the side.
